text: function retrieves thresholds settings global tidyweather options via weather_options(). default frost threshold get_weather_option("extreme.frost_threshold") require_full_year get_weather_option("require_full_year"). can changed using weather_options(). function designed work grouped tibbles (e.g., dplyr::group_by()), applying summary per group.

title: Summarise Weather Extremes and Key Indicators — summarise_weather
code: library(dplyr) #>  #> Attaching package: ‘dplyr’ #> The following objects are masked from ‘package:stats’: #>  #>     filter, lag #> The following objects are masked from ‘package:base’: #>  #>     intersect, setdiff, setequal, union  # Example weather data (daily minimum temperatures) weather_data <- read_weather(system.file("extdata/ppd_72150.met", package = "tidyweather"))  # Summarise without grouping weather_options(require_full_year = FALSE) summarise_weather(weather_data) #> # A tibble: 1 × 2 #>   number_frost_days last_frost_day #>               <int>          <dbl> #> 1                38            580  # Summarise by group (e.g., year) weather_data_grouped <- weather_data %>% group_by(year) summarise_weather(weather_data_grouped) #> # A tibble: 3 × 3 #> # Groups:   year [3] #>    year number_frost_days last_frost_day #>   <dbl>             <int>          <dbl> #> 1  2023                 0             NA #> 2  2024                29            262 #> 3  2025                 9            183
